name: Eve Bethel
source:
“...I am Eve Bethel.
The one who stepped down from the special seat.
Welcome, Visitor. And… I am sorry.”

The sleeping princess of the Ruined World.

Having grown disillusioned with all existence, she drifts through a void of nothingness.
